nodes.name: Webhook Upload
nodes.notes: Receives multipart/form-data with a single CSV file field named 'file' from the upload UI. POST /webhook/ingest

nodes.name: Parse + Normalize
nodes.notes: Stateless helper: validates rows, maps employment_status to {salaried, self_employed}, coerces numbers, assigns a batch_id. Returns valid rows + rejected sample.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: 'no valid rows', batch_id: $json.batch_id, missing_headers: $json.missing_headers, rejected_count: $json.rejected_count, rejected_sample: $json.rejected_sample }) }}

parameters.query: =WITH incoming AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.valid || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb) AS x(user_id text, name text, email text, monthly_income numeric, credit_score int, employment_status text, age int, batch_id uuid)), up AS (INSERT INTO users (user_id, name, email, monthly_income, credit_score, employment_status, age, batch_id) SELECT i.user_id, i.name, i.email, i.monthly_income, i.credit_score, i.employment_status, i.age, i.batch_id FROM incoming i ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, email = EXCLUDED.email, monthly_income = EXCLUDED.monthly_income, credit_score = EXCLUDED.credit_score, employment_status = EXCLUDED.employment_status, age = EXCLUDED.age, batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted) SELECT (SELECT batch_id FROM incoming LIMIT 1) AS batch_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE inserted) AS inserted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inserted) AS updated FROM up;

nodes.name: Bulk Insert Users
nodes.notes: Attach 'Postgres - LoanDB' credential. Single set-based upsert of the whole batch; idempotent on user_id. n8n owns the DB write (helper stays stateless).

nodes.name: Trigger Workflow B
nodes.notes: Fires the matching pipeline for the batch that was just stored. This is the event-driven handoff: ingestion -> matching.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', batch_id: $('Bulk Insert Users').item.json.batch_id, inserted: $('Bulk Insert Users').item.json.inserted, updated: $('Bulk Insert Users').item.json.updated, valid_count: $('Parse + Normalize').item.json.valid_count, rejected_count: $('Parse + Normalize').item.json.rejected_count }) }}
